  • Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
  • Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

Apoiar a liderança e as operações da loja como terceiro responsável e gerenciar a equipe designada. • Colaborar na obtenção dos KPIs da loja e garantir que a equipe tenha ciência deles e da forma como contribuem, e sugerir ajustes necessários para aumentar a produtividade e a eficiência no atendimento e na área de vendas.

• Supervisionar e apoiar as diferentes tarefas da loja (por exemplo, caixa, estoque e vendas), executando-as em conjunto com a equipe, se necessário, para garantir o funcionamento da loja e o atendimento ao consumidor.

• Liderar, motivar a equipe designada e apoiar o recrutamento e o treinamento de outros membros da equipe, fornecendo as ferramentas necessárias para ter performance e atingir os objetivos da loja, garantindo o engajamento dos funcionários, a produtividade e a cultura de alta performance, e liderando pelo exemplo enquanto defensor da Marca, demonstrando consistentemente a cultura para reforçar os valores da adidas.

• Trabalhar sempre priorizando a equipe, em total respeito com todos os colegas e contribuindo ativamente para tornar seu local de trabalho um ambiente inclusivo e acolhedor para todos.

title: Data Architect (Data Modeling & Optimization)
description:
About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.

Additional Information

About Us

At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Senior Cost Controller
description:
Position: Senior Cost Controller

Location: Barra da Tijuca

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The Senior Cost Controller is responsible for ensuring accurate financial control, cost management, and compliance across business units, supporting operational performance and strategic decision-making, particularly within FPSO operations.

Key Responsibilities

Manage accounts receivable processes, including aging reports and timely customer collections;

Ensure accurate and timely posting of invoices and revenue entries;

Manage billing processes, ensuring charges are issued in accordance with signed contracts and agreements;

Ensure compliance with Brazilian withholding tax regulations and statutory requirements;

Support month-end and year-end closing activities;

Prepare and review monthly accruals and revenue reconciliations;

Review, analyze, and explain variances in monthly and quarterly management and vessel reports (ERP);

Ensure timely and reliable financial closing and statutory reporting;

Maintain, review, and improve accounting procedures, processes, and internal controls;

Ensure group reporting meets corporate, audit, and tax compliance requirements;

Liaise with operations and provide finance/accounting support to business units;

Resolve accounting and financial queries and support cross-functional activities as needed.

Requirements

Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in FPSO or offshore oil & gas operations;

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields;

Fluent English;

Strong knowledge of financial controls, cost management, and Brazilian tax legislation;

Experience with IFS ERP is a strong advantage.

Annual Bonus

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
  • Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
  • Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.

Our compensation package:

- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).

- Profit Sharing.

- Transportation vouchers.

- Meals vouchers.

- Health and Dental insurance.

- Birthday day off.

- Gympass / Totalpass.

If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Analista de processos de TI
description:
Atuará na análise, desenho, documentação e melhoria contínua de processos organizacionais, garantindo eficiência operacional, conformidade regulatória e integração entre áreas de negócio e TI. Será responsável por apoiar a gestão na implementação de mudanças, auditorias e acompanhamento de planos de ação.

Principais Responsabilidades

Analisar, discutir e desenhar processos organizacionais (atuais e futuros).

Elaborar documentação detalhada de processos, incluindo:

Políticas

Diagramas de fluxo

Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POPs)

Instruções de trabalho

Identificar ineficiências, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos.

Propor e recomendar otimizações para aumento da eficiência operacional e produtividade.

Apoiar a implementação de mudanças nos processos, garantindo conformidade com padrões e regulamentos.

Realizar avaliações de riscos e impactos durante mudanças de processos.

Reportar riscos, impactos e status das iniciativas à gestão.

Atuar na gestão e acompanhamento de auditorias internas e externas.

Controlar e acompanhar planos de ação decorrentes de auditorias ou melhorias de processos.

Requisitos Desejáveis

Experiência em mapeamento e melhoria de processos.

Conhecimento em documentação de processos (fluxogramas, POPs, instruções de trabalho).

Capacidade analítica para identificação de gargalos e riscos.

Boa comunicação para interação com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

Organização e disciplina para controle de planos de ação e auditorias.

Diferenciais

Experiência com metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, BPM, Six Sigma, etc.).

Vivência em ambientes regulados ou com auditorias recorrentes.

Experiência em projetos de transformação de processos ou digitalização.

Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

description: About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization. Key Responsibilities Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process. Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures. Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems. Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness. Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability. Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories. Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels. Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs. Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations. Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes. Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable). Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting). Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance. Professional proficiency in English.Preferred Qualifications Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services. Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers. Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs. Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.Our compensation package: - Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT). - Profit Sharing. - Transportation vouchers. - Meals vouchers. - Health and Dental insurance. - Birthday day off. - Gympass / Totalpass.If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. title: Master Data Modeler
description: Position Summary and LocationSupport the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.Duties and Responsibilities Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data. Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies. Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices. Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data. Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures. Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems. Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems. Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications. Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes. Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage. Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members. Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field. Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus. Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures. Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect, SAP PowerDesigner, or similar tools. Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures. Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.Desired Qualifications Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design. Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL. Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect
description: About YouYou are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams. You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: 5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience. Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones. Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management. Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments. Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance. Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity. Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture. Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards. Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication. Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have). Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices. Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation. Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging. Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines. Design and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation. Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity. Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls. Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption. Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams. Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence. Qualifications 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (YAML) Advanced English proficiency. Additional Information About Us At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Azure Devops Engineer
description:
About you

You are a senior-level DevOps Engineer who enjoys designing, automating, and operating secure, scalable cloud platforms. You thrive in complex environments where infrastructure reliability, automation, and security are critical. You’re comfortable owning infrastructure decisions end to end and collaborating closely with architects and engineering teams to enable high-performing, cloud-native solutions.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in senior or staff-level DevOps / Infrastructure Engineering roles.
  • Professional certifications such as Azure DevOps, Terraform , or similar (preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and automation tools such as env0 (or equivalent).
  • Strong proficiency with Azure services, including networking, Managed Identities, Key Vault, App Services, AKS, Cosmos DB, Cognitive Search, and Azure OpenAI.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Deep expertise in identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta.
  • Advanced skills in CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps , and related toolchains.
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and automation scripting using Bash, PowerShell, and/or Python.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms, including Datadog and Azure Application Insights.
  • Proven track record contributing to or leading complex cloud infrastructure initiatives in fast-paced or large-scale environments.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and env0. Automate deployments to ensure scalability, consistency, and security.
  • Manage Azure networking, databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB), and identity tools (Entra ID, Okta). Ensure robust access controls and platform reliability.
  • Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps. Embed best practices for testing, versioning, and automated releases.
  • Implement observability using Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Monitor performance, resolve issues proactively, and optimize cost and reliability.
  • Partner with architects and engineers to align on infrastructure standards. Promote DevOps culture, automation, and continuous improvement.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. description:
Resumo do cargo:

O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sitemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);
  • Levantamento dedados, elaboração de fluxogramas, diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
  • Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
  • Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
  • Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.E. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
  • Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
  • Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
  • Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
  • Comissionamentode novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

title: Master Data Modeler
description:
Position Summary and Location

Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
  • Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
  • Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
  • Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
  • Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
  • Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
  • Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
  • Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
  • Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
  • Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
  • Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.G., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect, SAP PowerDesigner, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
  • Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.


Desired Qualifications

  • Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design.
  • Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.


Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.


This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams.


You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
  • Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments.
  • Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
  • Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture.
  • Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication.
  • Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices.
  • Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
  • Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
  • Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
  • Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
  • Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
  • Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
  • Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
  • Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (YAML)
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Especialista De Planejamento Tributário
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Pessoa Analista De Controles Internos Sr.
description:
Através de um portfólio completo com foco na descarbonização de infraestruturas de energia, a ENGIE oferece soluções integradas capazes de transformar cidades e empresas para que façam o melhor uso da energia baseadas em dois pilares: redução de custos e de emissões de CO2. Desta forma, as soluções customizadas de Autoprodução de energia Solar, Eficiência Energética, Subestações, HVAC, Geração de vapor, Consultoria e Gerenciamento de Energia atendem toda a cadeia otimizando a relação com a energia em diversos setores como Indústria, Shopping Centers, Varejo Multisites, Aeroportos, Hospitais, entre outros.

Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente.

Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário.

A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

Missão do Cargo

Garantir a integridade operacional e regulatória da empresa por meio do desenvolvimento, monitoramento e aprimoramento contínuo dos controles internos, promovendo a mitigação de riscos e a conformidade com normas internas e externas.

Principais Atividades

1. Identificar e avaliar riscos operacionais, financeiros e de conformidade associados às atividades da empresa de energia renovável.

2. Executar auditorias internas periódicas para avaliar a eficácia dos controles internos e identificar oportunidades de melhoria.

3. Manter-se atualizado sobre regulamentações do setor, garantindo aderência aos controles internos.

4. Fornecer treinamento e orientação aos colaboradores sobre práticas e controles internos, fomentando cultura de conformidade.

5. Desenvolver protocolos para tratamento de incidentes de não conformidade, investigando irregularidades e definindo medidas corretivas.

6. Preparar relatórios regulares sobre desempenho dos controles internos, com análises e recomendações à alta administração.

7. Colaborar com TI para integrar controles internos aos sistemas corporativos, promovendo abordagem sistêmica.

8. Avaliar eficiência e eficácia dos processos de negócio, propondo melhorias para otimização e redução de riscos.

9. Facilitar auditorias externas, garantindo fornecimento de documentação e informações necessárias.

10. Efetuar os testes e análises de acordo com as instruções do Grupo para o programa global de controles internos.

Requisitos

  • Superior completo: Administração, Economia, Contabilidade e áreas afins;
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado;
  • Pacote office Intermediário.


Desejável

  • Especialização (Pós-Graduação/MBA) Administração, Economia, Contabilidade e áreas afins;
  • Pacote Office –Avançado
  • Conhecimento em processos de controles internos
  • Experiência em Big 4

Local de Trabalho

Rio de Janeiro/RJ - Brasil

A ENGIE valoriza e estimula uma cultura de diversidade e inclusão, com orientação para igualdade entre as pessoas, respeito pela vida privada de todos e é contra qualquer forma de discriminação e assédio.

title: Compliance And Aml Counsel
description:
The Compliance and AML Counsel will serve as a key member of the compliance function, advising internal stakeholders on a broad range of regulatory compliance matters, with a particular focus on anti-money laundering, sanctions, and financial crime prevention.


RESPONSABILITIES

i. Supporting the design, implementation, and enhancement of Maha Capital's AML and sanctions compliance programs in accordance with applicable laws and regulatory guidance. iii. Drafting and negotiating compliance-related provisions in commercial agreements, conducting risk assessments and gap analyses of existing compliance frameworks, and advising internal business units on regulatory/ compliance developments affecting the company and its operations.

i. Bachelor’s degree in law.

ii. Minimum 4 years of experience

i. Srong knowledge of compliance, AML and sanctions laws.

ii. Excellent legal research, writing, and analytical skills are essential, as is the ability to communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly to internal stakeholders at all levels.

iii. Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects in different jurisdictions simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

iv. Strong working knowledge of major anti-corruption and anti-bribery frameworks, including: U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA), UK Bribery Act, Brazilian Anti-Corruption Law (Law No. 12,846/2013 – Clean Company Act) and related regulations

v. Ability to interpret and apply anti-corruption principles across multiple jurisdictions where the Company operates.

vi. Experience advising on interactions with public officials, third-party risk management, and internal controls designed to prevent bribery and corruption.

vii. Capacity to align local compliance requirements with international best practices and global compliance standards


SOFT SKILLS

i. Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

ii. Effective planning and priority setting

iv. Teamwork

v. Clear and effective written and verbal communication

vi. Interpersonal and presentation skills

vii. Analytical skills

title: Consultoria Interna De Rh – Business Partner (Áreas Comerciais)
description:

Por isso investimos em um ambiente saudável, oferecemos boas oportunidades de crescimento, promovemos a colaboração e a troca de conhecimento.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho é colaborativo, e nosso pacote de benefícios, robusto e altamente atrativo, complementa o cuidado e reforça o compromisso com as nossas pessoas.

Sobre a posição:

A Icatu Seguros é uma das maiores seguradoras do mercado de Previdência, Vida e Capitalização, nós somos especialistas em pessoas e ajudamos a planejar o futuro, proteger o presente e realizar projetos em cada fase da vida.

title: Estagiário De Design
description:
ESCOPO DA VAGA

O(a) estagiário(a) de Design atuará no desenvolvimento de estampas corridas e localizadas, aplicadas em diferentes produtos de moda e adaptadas a múltiplas técnicas de impressão — como cilindro, digital, silk screen, entre outras. Além do desenvolvimento criativo, a pessoa também apoiará os designers da equipe em demandas pontuais, podendo contribuir com organização de materiais, atualização de plataformas internas e manutenção dos fluxos de trabalho. Embora possam existir tarefas ligadas à organização e processos, o foco principal da vaga é o desenvolvimento criativo e a evolução técnica em estamparia.


QUER FAZER PARTE DESTA JORNADA COM A GENTE?


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Criar, desenvolver e desdobrar estampas e silks, contribuindo para a construção de linguagens visuais inéditas e coerentes com as coleções.
  • Desenvolver estampas-mãe e seus respectivos desdobramentos para diferentes categorias de produto.
  • Evoluir traços, composições cromáticas e soluções gráficas com consistência estética.
  • Aplicar artes em CADs, revisando encaixes, rapport e engenharia de produto.
  • Criar arquivos em Illustrator e Photoshop respeitando as exigências técnicas da estamparia e da indústria têxtil.
  • Realizar pesquisas visuais e construir repertório autoral relevante para cada briefing.
  • Retrabalhar artes a partir de feedbacks da coordenação e liderança criativa.
  • Garantir organização de arquivos, padronização de nomenclaturas e correto compartilhamento com o time.
  • Atualizar Trello e Miro com status, referências, versões e histórico de evolução das artes.
  • Cumprir prazos e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos pela equipe.


ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Criar e evoluir estampas, silks e elementos gráficos.
  • Ajustar composições, cores e proporções conforme direcionamento.
  • Preparar arquivos finalizáveis para produção.
  • Atualizar plataforma interna de estampas.
  • Organizar boards e materiais de pesquisa.
  • Participar de alinhamentos criativos.
  • Apoiar a equipe em demandas estratégicas do fluxo criativo.



Requisitos e qualificações:


FORMAÇÃO E CONHECIMENTOS TÉCNICOS

  • Estar cursando Design Gráfico, Artes Visuais ou áreas correlatas.
  • Domínio de Illustrator e Photoshop.
  • Inglês iniciante (mínimo).
  • Alto nível de desenho: domínio de traço, forma, composição e interpretação autoral de cor.


Desejável:

  • Procreate.
  • Vivência com Trello e Miro.
  • Experiência com moda (malha, tecido plano, t-shirts, silk).
  • Conhecimento em estampas corridas, barradas e engenharias.
  • Know-how em pesquisa criativa aplicada à moda.

title: Gerente De Comunicação (Interna)
description:
Sobre a empresa


Desde o século XIX, a Granado encanta gerações com produtos de qualidade e uma abordagem sustentável. A marca, com mais de 150 anos, mantém valores sólidos e acompanha as necessidades de seu tempo, crescendo sem perder a essência.


Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, destacando-se por fragrâncias marcantes e de alta qualidade. Phebo se tornou sinônimo de luxo e excelência no mercado brasileiro. Acreditamos que o clássico não precisa ser antigo, utilizando cores vivas, fragrâncias atuais e ingredientes modernos.


Nossa história centenária apoia um futuro inovador, presente em cada produto, loja e embalagem. Valorizamos o bem-estar, a segurança no trabalho e a preservação ambiental. Nosso sucesso é fruto de equipes qualificadas e apaixonadas. Diariamente, escrevemos novos capítulos dessa trajetória de sucesso.


Grupo Granado abre as portas para você!


Como Gerente de Comunicação Interna, reportando-se à Gerência Executiva de Recursos Humanos, você terá papel chave de estruturar e consolidar a estratégia de Comunicação Interna do Grupo Granado, fortalecendo a cultura, promovendo alinhamento institucional e assegurando uma comunicação clara e estratégica em momentos estratégicos, sensíveis ou de transformação.


Principais atribuições:


  • Liderar a agenda de Comunicação Interna, definindo diretrizes, governança, prioridades e posicionamento.
  • Atuar como consultor, aconselhando gestores, traduzindo temas complexos em mensagens claras e apoiando decisões.
  • Desenvolver e implementar iniciativas de cultura, engajamento e employer branding, conectando EVP, propósito e práticas de RH.
  • Estruturar narrativas corporativas, discursos executivos e comunicações para público interno.
  • Desenvolver campanhas, ativações e projetos de grande impacto, com foco em mobilização, engajamento, pertencimento e consistência de marca empregadora.
  • Gerenciar indicadores, percepções internas e clima organizacional, propondo planos de ação estratégicos.
  • Gerenciar canais institucionais internos garantindo comunicação integrada: intranet, newsletters, town halls, eventos executivos, notas estratégicas e comunicados oficiais internos.
  • Administrar orçamento, fornecedores, com visão de eficiência e excelência.


O que buscamos?


  • Formação completa em Comunicação, Jornalismo, RP, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em liderança de Comunicação Interna, preferencialmente em empresas estruturadas ou de grande porte.
  • Forte habilidade de relacionamento em todos os níveis, influência e visão estratégica do negócio.
  • Excelência em comunicação escrita, narrativa corporativa e gestão de mensagens sensíveis.
  • Necessário Inglês.
  • Diferenciais: Experiência em bens de consumo, varejo premium ou marcas com identidade institucional forte.
  • Visão estratégica ampla, alta capacidade de influência, leitura de ambiente, raciocínio crítico, organização e habilidade para navegar em contextos complexos com discrição e clareza.


Atuação presencial em nossa Matriz no RJ.


Confira o que você pode esperar:


- Um ambiente integrado, leve e acolhedor, onde a colaboração, o respeito e a parceria fazem parte da nossa rotina.

- Horário flexível, promovendo mais autonomia para você organizar sua rotina e ganhar qualidade de vida.

- Vale-Refeição, para você aproveitar suas pausas com tranquilidade e bons momentos.

- Plano de saúde, plano odontológico e seguro de vida, porque cuidar de você e de quem você ama é prioridade.

- TotalPass, incentivando o movimento, a energia e o equilíbrio entre corpo e mente.

- Descontos exclusivos nas nossas marcas: Granado, Phebo e Care Natural Beauty — porque quem faz parte também merece aproveitar.

- Um ambiente que estimula a criatividade, a inovação e o aprendizado contínuo, com apoio ao seu desenvolvimento por meio do Programa de Educação Continuada , que inclui subsídios para cursos de aprimoramento, graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.

- Parcerias educacionais com instituições como Estácio e Open English , facilitando ainda mais sua jornada de desenvolvimento.

- Programa de Participação nos Resultados , valorizando e reconhecendo quem cresce junto e contribui com nossa história.


Escritório no Edifício Vista Guanabara , com uma vista inspiradora que traz mais leveza e bem-estar à rotina de trabalho


Aqui, tradição e inovação caminham lado a lado — e você pode fazer parte disso!

The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.

· Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.

· Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.

· Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.

· Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.

Requirements

· Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).

· Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

· Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.

· Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.

· Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.

· Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).

· Clear and structured written communication skills.

· Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.

Differentials

· Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.

· Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.

· Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.G., Python, VBA, Power BI).

Benefits

· Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.

· Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm.

· Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.

· Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Estagiário De Engenharia
description:
Sobre a DTX


A DTX é uma empresa líder na indústria aeroespacial. Conhecida por sua abordagem inovadora e tecnologia de ponta, a empresa é especializada no design, fabricação e manutenção de trens de pouso. Com um forte foco em qualidade e segurança, estabelecemos-nos como um parceiro confiável para muitas das principais companhias aéreas e organizações militares em todo o mundo. Estamos comprometidos com a melhoria contínua e a sustentabilidade, investindo pesadamente em pesquisa e desenvolvimento para impulsionar a indústria.


Sobre o trabalho


Estamos buscando novos estagiários para compor nosso time de engenharia.

O foco deste programa de estágio é a formação técnica de futuros engenheiros especialistas em trem de pouso em processos de MRO.

O estagiário irá passar por todas as áreas do setor em esquema de "job rotation " para que possa aprender sobre o processo de trens de pouso de forma global.


1. Suporte de projeto e engenharia

Tarefas:

  • Apoiar os engenheiros na análise e revisão das especificações do projeto.
  • Auxiliar na avaliação de desenhos, esquemas e especificações para componentes do trem de pouso.
  • Saiber como as equipes de engenharia dão suporte ao processo de produção e manutenção.

Habilidades adquiridas:

  • Compreensão dos princípios de design para componentes aeroespaciais
  • Familiaridade com software CAD e desenhos de engenharia
  • Técnicas de resolução de problemas em engenharia aeroespacial


2. Análise de Tensão e Teste de Material

Tarefas de rotação:

  • Auxiliar em cálculos de análise de tensão ou simulações para componentes do trem de pouso.
  • Participar de testes de materiais, como testes de tração, fadiga e corrosão.
  • Observar o uso da Análise de Elementos Finitos (FEA) para componentes do trem de pouso.

Habilidades adquiridas:

  • Princípios básicos de estresse, tensão e ciência dos materiais
  • Uso de ferramentas de simulação (por exemplo, FEA)
  • Aplicação de testes de materiais em engenharia aeronáutica


3. Conformidade Regulatória e Documentação

Tarefas:

  • Saber mais sobre o papel dos órgãos reguladores (FAA, ANAC, EASA...) nas operações de MRO.
  • Auxiliar na documentação dos procedimentos de manutenção, inspeção e reparo.
  • Entender como manter a conformidade com os padrões de aeronavegabilidade.

Habilidades adquiridas:

  • Familiaridade com normas e certificações regulatórias
  • Sistemas de gerenciamento e rastreamento de documentação
  • Atenção aos protocolos de conformidade e aeronavegabilidade


4. Gestão e Coordenação de Projetos

Tarefas:

  • Acompanhar os gerentes de projeto para entender o agendamento e a alocação de recursos.
  • Auxiliar no gerenciamento de cronogramas e documentação de projetos para projetos de revisão de trens de pouso.
  • Ajudar na coordenação entre as equipes de produção, engenharia e qualidade.

Habilidades adquiridas:

  • Habilidades de gerenciamento de tempo e coordenação de projetos
  • Compreensão das ferramentas e técnicas de gerenciamento de projetos
  • Comunicação e colaboração interdepartamental


5. Suporte de campo e interação com o cliente

Tarefas:

  • Auxiliar na prestação de suporte técnico aos clientes (companhias aéreas, militares, etc.) quando necessário.
  • Observar as visitas dos clientes e ajude a explicar os processos de reparo.
  • Participar da análise de causa raiz para problemas recorrentes de trem de pouso.

Habilidades adquiridas:

  • Habilidades de comunicação com o cliente em um contexto técnico
  • Resolução de problemas e análise de causa raiz
  • Coordenação entre engenharia e atendimento ao cliente


Requisitos e informações da vaga:

  • O candidato deve obrigatoriamente estar cursando nível superior em Engenharia.
  • A instituição de ensino deve fornecer à empresa um modelo de contrato de estágio.
  • Duração inicial de 06 meses podendo ser renovado por mais 06 meses com chance de efetivação ao final.
  • O candidato precisa ter disponibilidade para trabalhar de forma 100% presencial na área industrial do Aeroporto do Galeão - RJ.

title: Remote Ai Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.G., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Remote Ai Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.G., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

description:
Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.


Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from "Bronze" (Raw) to "Silver" (Cleaned) and "Gold" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time;
    make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.


Qualifications


Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data;
    you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.
